The '''Salis D'aar Medical Center''' was a medical facility located within the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]], which served as [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].<ref name="GatORW" />
